Intermediate

Experience the ultimate kitesurfing adventure in Tarifa, Europe's wind capital. This week-long camp combines professional instruction with the best conditions the continent has to offer.

Whether you're looking to master new tricks or progress to the next level, our experienced instructors will guide you every step of the way. With consistent winds and perfect flat water, Tarifa provides the ideal learning environment.

Join us for an unforgettable week of kitesurfing, new friendships, and memories that will last a lifetime.
